It requires a [[Defence]] level of 10 to wear, and can be purchased from [[Seddu's Adventurers' Store]] in [[Nardah]] for 576 coins. It can be received as an uncommon drop from [[dark warrior]]s, and a common drop from [[mutated bloodveld]]s. It can also be obtained through [[shade burning]], and is quite commonly found at the [[Digsite]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -3 |arange = 0 |dstab = +9 |dslash = +10 |dcrush = +8 |dmagic = -1 |drange = +9 |str = +0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = +0 |slot = head |image = [[File:Black med helm equipped male.png|130px]] |altimage = [[File:Black med helm equipped female.png|130px]] }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black med helm}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black med helm}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The medium helmet's ranged attack bonus has been increased from -1 to 0. }} {{Subject changes |date = 17 July 2007 |update = Game Improvements (July 2007) |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 4 May –
